name: Play It Forward
tagline: Matches families who need toys with households that have extras, by children's ages and interests.
problem: Rising costs leave some families unable to celebrate holidays.
solution: Listings and a matching algorithm pair donated toys with families at no cost.
demo_moment: Team-described: list a toy and see it matched to a family.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[MLH] Best .Tech Domain Name” among 169 submissions.

lessons: Even small domain-name prizes go to projects with a clear purpose.
